method: Whole session.c/h read; Git blob verification, static lifecycle analysis.
findings: Abort counter and warning-once state are process-global and not reset in session_init. Reusing multiple sessions after cancellation would require external reset or process restart; call sites still to inspect.
Second acknowledged interrupt calls exit(EXIT_FAILURE), providing hard process termination rather than bounded cooperative cleanup. Normal abort only checked at strategic caller points.
Session clear closes formats and frees root paths before rm_mds_free waits scheduler. Correctness requires work already drained before clear; top-level sequence still unreviewed.
Session clear delegates file ownership to previously inspected file-table destructor, so early all_files elements are not independently cleaned here. Reachable early path still unproven.
Kernel version parse uses sscanf result !=EOF instead of requiring2 fields, and unknown version returns true. This is a capability heuristic, not physical ioctl feature proof.

equal_exit_code initialized failure; earlier shred loop treats failure as abort condition. Formatter/main initialization must be inspected to understand ordinary scan startup, not assume from these modules alone.
Header mentions session-cached kernel version, but implementation caches process-wide through GOnce. Regex cache is per-session and freed during clear.
limits: No original process lifecycle tests or runtime bug reproduction.
